intro: Sick of hearing the same stale party songs from glossy, mimed promo videos? For events that simply must stand out, choose Deep Cuts.

A premium four-piece built for those who demand something extraordinary, Deep Cuts skips overdone clichés to play the actual anthems people love. The tracks that make guests shout "OMG YES!" as they storm the dance floor. Singalong bangers? Oooh yes. Stale party picks? No chance.
The lineup features four elite UK session musicians with a collective resume including Glastonbury, Wembley, and multiple global stadium tours. You’re booking the best.
If you love live music, and a world-class show is non-negotiable, it has to be Deep Cuts.

members.name: Callum
members.bio: Callum has toured and played/toured/recorded with Frank Turner and The Sleeping Souls, Get Cape. Wear Cape. Fly, Kate Nash, Emily Barker, and more. A few of his career highlights include: touring 50 states in 50 days (only 2 groups of people have ever completed this); playing major festivals including Reading, Leeds; and supporting Bruce Springsteen and Sting. To cap it off, Callum has appeared on major media outlets, including BBC Maida Vale, Sky Arts, BBC Radio 1, 2 and 6music.

members.name: Jack
members.bio: Jack’s career has taken him touring all over the world, from Australia to the USA and all across Europe. He’s played with artists such as Venbee and Sawyer Hill, among others. Plus, he’s performed on many great stages including Glastonbury, Reading and Leeds Festivals, as well as Later with Jools Holland.

members.name: Lee
members.bio: Lee began his career in music at the age of 16, touring globally throughout with artists including Ed Sheeran, Paolo Nutini, KT Tunstall, Texas, Willy Mason, and many more. Notable venues include Wembley Stadium, Glastonbury Festival, Shepherds Bush Empire, Nashville’s Ryman Auditorium and Grand Ole Opry. Lee spent six years working as a songwriter for Universal Music Publishing, living and working in Nashville, TN.

members.name: Phil
members.role: Double Bass, Electric Bass & Backing Vocals
members.bio: Phil has played with Get Cape. Wear Cape. Fly, Dele Sosimi, and many more. Across his career, he’s performed at many main stage festivals such as Isle of Wight, Reading, Leeds, Love Supreme, Barn on The Farm, London Jazz Festival – plus Late Late Shows at the iconic jazz venue Ronnie Scotts. If that wasn’t enough, Phil runs a recording studio from home which is constantly booked out, with many of the resulting records featured on BBC Radio stations 1, 2 and 6.
